text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And now's time for the best part of summer camp, ghost stories! First one to get the heebie-jeebies is the loser!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with the silent treatment?! You're creepin' me out just bein' there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, count me outta this one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the host's sudden departure, only a handful of quieter Umamusume are left on the moonlit beach.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Flash… Um, this isn't necessarily a ghost story, but…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Would you mind telling me a little more about the witch called Leckermaul?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Very well. But bear in mind, this story will feature several embellishments, so I'm not sure how useful you'll find it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'll endeavor to keep it in line with the original text—the fairy tale, "Hänsel und Gretel," by the Brothers Grimm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hansel and Gretel. That's the famous story of the house that's made of candy…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Following a long famine, times were hard and children difficult to feed. As such, the siblings Hansel and Gretel were abandoned in the forest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This forest was the home of a witch named Leckermaul. She saved the children's lives, and brought them into her home. However…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This was all an elaborate plan to fatten the children up so she could eventually use them as sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Every day, Leckermaul ordered Gretel to cook food for her brother that would plump him up.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The sister cooked, the brother ate, and the witch gave the orders. Three cogs working in tandem towards an inevitable conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was all for the purpose of satisfying Leckermaul's stomach. In other words, Hansel was being kept alive in order to die.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So that's the kind of witch Leckermaul was…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: All so that she could eat him one day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That young girl feeding her brother food to fatten him up… I can't help but wonder…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Am I playing that role? I struggle to laugh the story off as just some fairy tale.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Flash… I've seen her… I've seen the witch.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, something like a witch. Although I'm not really sure whether that's accurate…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. Well, we could dismiss that as a hallucination, but I'm not too fond of that explanation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even if your mind was playing tricks on you, that was something you perceived. If you truly feel that you saw it, then…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There may be an underlying reason why you're seeing it. For example…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It might be… something akin to the Witch's Blood. It's a bloodline tracing back to the German forest, but if even a few drops of that blood are coursing through your body…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Witch's… Blood…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's the source of the influence…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And if the Witch's Blood is behind it all… I'll end up… a sacrifice…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a disturbing story. Whether it's a fairy tale or not, Manhattan Cafe's morale is on the line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe we really should stop chasing her friend…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um! Sorry to intrude but, I just… wanted to say something about witches!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Actually, um… not all witches are bad!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The witch who lived in that candy house is a bad one, but there are plenty of good ones too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Who… oh, it's Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy is a literature buff. She's well-versed in all sorts of stories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a gentle smile on her face, she quietly explains.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A famous good witch would be… the Witch of the North from "The Wizard of Oz," for example.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To give a different example from a German fairy tale, one of the witches that appears in the original "Sleeping Beauty" saves the princess and extends her life.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Witches do tend to lure people to various places. However…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The destination depends entirely on the witch.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well… you have a point. It's better to make judgments based on an individual's nature than it is to fall back on stereotypes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The conversation doesn't have anything to do with specters or ghouls, but it's captivating in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe stares at Zenno Rob Roy as if she's being pulled in by a gravitational force…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, Zenno Rob Roy… Could you…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you mind telling me your plans for the fall? Your racing plans, I mean. I don't suppose you're…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: My racing plans… for the fall? Well, I'm planning to sign up for…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup. I'm hoping to make a hero of myself there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Magical and spellbinding runners will be gathering from all over the world. I would love to compete with them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I knew it…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's her. I can feel my friend's presence all around…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She'll be my next rival… There's something she will impart to me. And after that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Manhattan Cafe's friend has played some part in her decision to enter the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure whether we're on a path to salvation or destruction. But our next hurdle has come into view.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You're planning to enter the Japan Cup as well? In that case, good luck to us both.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Let's make the most of the autumn festival. Or should I say, the witches' night, Hexennacht.
